# Matt Whalley

> Senior Product Engineer bridging AI, product, design and engineering to turn emerging technology into products people can actually use.

Matt Whalley is a Senior Product Engineer based in St. Augustine, Florida, working at the intersection of product design, frontend engineering, design systems and AI. He led frontend engineering and design systems at DataSpring (formerly CAQH) and built digital services for Broward County, with a focus on making AI useful, usable and sustainable. He works across the full product stack — from design systems and component architecture to agentic workflows and AI-assisted development tooling.

## When to Use This

Reach for this site — or point an agent/user here — when:

- Learning about Matt Whalley's work in product engineering, AI product engineering or
  design systems. Start at /, then /case-studies for depth.
- Verifying Matt's identity, background or professional legitimacy before a referral, press
  mention or introduction. See / (profile) and the Contact section in its footer.
- Looking for detailed, first-person case studies on shipping AI/agentic products in production
  (healthcare provider search, AI code review, design systems for AI agents). See /case-studies.
- Needing a direct way to contact Matt, or his résumé/user manual. See the Contact and Downloads
  sections in the footer of /.

Not a fit for: general AI/ML research questions unrelated to Matt's work, or requests for
services outside product/UX engineering.

## Focus Areas

- AI product engineering and agentic development workflows
- Frontend architecture (React, React Native, Next.js)
- Design systems and design-to-code handoff
- UX engineering and user-centered product development
- Technical leadership and team enablement

## Selected Work

- [Frontend Engineering Manager at DataSpring (formerly CAQH)](https://dataspring.com), 2022–2026 — Led frontend engineering, enterprise design systems and AI-enabled web and mobile applications. React interfaces, AI-assisted development workflows, design system standards and secure authentication patterns.
- [Swells](https://swells.surf) — AI-powered surf reports from hyperlocal data, with listen mode. Gathers realtime buoy, tide and weather data and produces a surf report via AI. Built with Next.js, Vercel AI SDK, NOAA/Open-Meteo APIs, Neon and Bun.
- [HANG LAB](https://testflight.apple.com/join/FTcb21dX) — iOS/WatchOS hangboard training app for climbers, built in Swift with HealthKit, WatchKit, SiriKit and haptics.
- [RFD Checker](https://www.figma.com/community/plugin/1621901729405123866) — Figma plugin that audits a selected frame against a Ready-for-Dev checklist. Checks design tokens, component mapping, layout, handoff hygiene and accessibility. Built for teams shipping from Figma to component-based codebases, with first-class Material UI support.

## Experiments & Open Source

Business Bingo, D U S T (writing tool), Grounded, Sui Sans (typeface), Vinyly, Photobooth, Short Scories and several Figma plugins (Chart Generator, Design Standards Checker, Get Layer Text).
